_comment: Skills synced in full to <project>/.claude/skills/ at session start (syncSkillsToProject in claude-session.ts). `skills` lists skills physically bundled in resources/skills/ (currently just aiux-tailwind-vision-spec) — every other skill is discovered dynamically from each externalPacks entry's installed npm package (its entire skills/ dir gets fetched into ~/Library/Application Support/AIUX Lab/skills/<name>/skills/), so it never needs to be hand-listed here.

skills.name: aiux-tailwind-vision-spec
skills.description: Deterministic mapping of AIUX visual patterns to DaisyUI aiux-* component classes and design tokens.
